items.description: Small black reading lamp with flexible neck and dimmable warm glow, no taller than 35 cm.
Grey ergonomic office chair with breathable mesh, adjustable lumbar support and armrests.
Wooden bookcase for about 40 books with rounded corners, not taller than my desk.
Brown bamboo computer desk with integrated cable tray and dual monitor workspace, at most 75 cm tall.
Blue steel storage cabinet with lockable doors and at least 60 litres, no taller than 65 cm.
